reasons.L1_ASSISTED: Autonomy Level L1 (Assisted): All modification actions require manual human approval
reasons.L2_RECOMMEND: Autonomy Level L2 (Recommend): Proposal created, awaiting CEO/Manager click approval
reasons.L3_MULTI_SIG: Expense of {amount} VND exceeds Multi-Sig threshold (>50m VND). Mandatory minimum 2 leadership signatures required.
reasons.L3_AUTO_APPROVED: Expense of {amount} VND is within L3 autonomous limit (<= 20m VND). Automatically executed.
reasons.L3_SINGLE_APPROVAL: Expense of {amount} VND exceeds L3 limit (20m VND) but below Multi-Sig threshold. Requires 1 CEO/CFO signature.
reasons.L4_MULTI_SIG: Even under L4, major financial decisions (>50m VND) trigger Multi-Sig Gate for security.
reasons.L4_FULLY_AUTONOMOUS: Action operates fully within high-level L4 autonomous framework

messages.VETO_TRIGGERED: All agent command execution streams and expenditures immediately suspended
messages.VETO_LIFTED: System emergency freeze lifted, normal operations restored
messages.DEFAULT_VETO_REASON: Critical risk detected or urgent CEO override request
